subtitle: Golden Visa Programme
overview:
Italy offers one of Europe's most attractive Golden Visa programmes, granting permanent residency in as little as 1–2 months for one of the lowest minimum investments in the EU.

Applicants receive pre-approval (Nulla Osta) before completing their investment, ensuring no funds are committed prior to confirmation. Investment options range from innovative startups to government bonds.

As the EU's 3rd largest economy, Italy provides stability, a Mediterranean lifestyle, and after 10 years of residence, eligibility to apply for citizenship and an EU passport.

No stay requirement: Golden Visa holders do not need to live in Italy continuously to maintain their residence permit, allowing full flexibility to travel.
benefit1Desc: Travel across the Schengen Area without a visa.
benefit2Desc: Keep your original nationality alongside the new one.
benefit3Desc: Spouse and dependent children up to age 18 included.
benefit4Desc: Live, work and study in the country from day one.
benefit5Desc: Attractive regimes for new residents on foreign income.
benefit6Desc: Eligible to apply for citizenship after the qualifying period.
inv1Desc: Invest in a qualifying innovative company to support local growth.
inv2Desc: Support local business growth and job creation.
inv3Desc: Non-refundable contribution to a government-recognised initiative.
inv4Desc: Stable, low-risk investment backed by the state.
step2Desc: Collect and legalise the application file (2–4 weeks)
step4Desc: Visa issued after the investment (2–4 weeks)
step6Desc: Receive residence permit and start your new life
supportText: One of Europe's most accessible and fastest-processing investor visa programmes — offering a direct pathway to EU residency and, after 10 years, Italian citizenship.
